invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Pair containing two objects, as shown by the return statement.
The left element of the result is the partitionPathStatMap, which is constructed as a non-null HashMap.
The right element of the result is globalStat, constructed as a new WorkloadStat and thus is non-null.
Each unique partitionPath in inputRecords leads to one entry in the map; thus, number of entries in the map cannot exceed the total number of records.
If there are no inputRecords, the resulting partitionPathStatMap will be empty.
